name: sleeve-lock
note: 10 Signature Sleeve Lock, v002 sketch (references/packaging/10_sleeve_lock_v002.png, 2026-11-12): 100 mm cube, lift-off lid ('lift along shape'). The seam is level at seam_side_z on the sides and back and drops in a V across the front to seam_low_z at the centre. Along the seam a `reveal` gap shows the lid's velvet lining, which hangs below the lid as a skirt (inset from the faces, half sizes `skirt`) down to the base rim; inside it a thick velvet collar on the base rises collar_rise above the seam; no gold beads along the seam (bead_height 0 since v004). A strap runs up the front, over the lid and down the back; a plain gold clasp on the lid sits on the strap at the V tip, across the reveal. Inside the collar a velvet ring pad of two rounded rolls. The perhaps wordmark in gold foil on the lid ceiling. Select colours: designer rib jacquard outside in the Select green, green leather strap, Select | interior lining.

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB (the jacquard swatch as colour on the cloth); renders swap in the library look via config/presets/box_sleeve_lock_look.json.
